# amiBrainAI
> AI Study & Learning Companion — dual-engine verified

## What is amiBrainAI?
amiBrainAI is a dual-engine AI study companion. Two AI models (Grok + DeepSeek) cross-verify every answer — concept explanations, flashcards, quizzes, and exam prep you can trust.

## Features
- Concept explanations at any level (ELI5 to PhD)
- Flashcard generation for active recall
- Quiz & exam prep (multiple choice, short answer, essay prompts)
- Concept mapping and relationship visualization
- Step-by-step problem solving (math, physics, CS)
- Multilingual support

## Architecture
- Dual-engine: Grok 4.5 (xAI) + DeepSeek
- Anti-confabulation: trigram-cosine concordance >= 0.45 required
- Stateless: study queries processed in real-time, never stored

## Compliance
- EU AI Act (Reg. 2024/1689) Art. 50 — limited-risk, full transparency
- GDPR (Reg. 2016/679) — minimal data, no query storage
